title: jaren-project
description: A jaren studio project: a thin envelope over a list of typed files. The envelope is schema-gated; each file's `text` is validated against ITS OWN kind grammar at its boundary, never composed into one mega-schema — so a data file may use host-registered operators the closed grammars forbid.

files.description: The project's files, each a named unit of one concern.

active.description: The name of the file the editor shows (falls back to the first file).

kind.description: The file's grammar/role; its `text` is validated against this kind, not the envelope.

imports.description: Top-level artifact member to project file name; replaces an absent member with the entire source JSON value.

model.description: Model file whose worker store executes this query.

collection.description: Collection in the referenced model; required when ambiguous.

layout.description: The IDE arrangement — frozen so it survives a share link and the eject.
